name: Tanaka Mitsuhiro
source:
An employee for a company listed on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. 
However, he is slow-witted and not very bright.

He works under [url=/c28415]Toujou Keiko[/url], who smacks him around every day. He used to do judo in school, so he is confident in his physical strength and thinks he is good at sex. 

He participates in the group as an outlet for his work stress.
